algorithms.FEDPROX: train_local_fedprox_epoch_v2 with the frozen FEDPROX_MU_V2 selected_mu (0.1); never request-supplied

run_level_base: FL_INIT_V2 (the only allowed run base in CAP-007; MODEL_V2_FINAL and CAPSTONE_FL_CANDIDATE_* are refused)

round_level_base_digests.round_N_gt_1: digest of the immediately preceding committed round global state

candidate_parent: FL_INIT_V2 (the run-level base), never an intermediate aggregate
arrival_order: canonical client order (the Coordinator sorts by client id before aggregation, so arrival order cannot change the aggregate)
aggregation_status_mode: always PLAIN (authoritative aggregation is plain weighted-delta aggregation in every run)

secagg_shadow.on_failure: run FAILED loudly; tolerances never widened

replay.source: most recent COMPLETED LIVE_RUN of the same owner with the same scenario/algorithm/secagg_mode/planned_rounds
replay.source_recorded_in: artifact run.json (replay_source_run_id); not a request field
replay.work: zero training / submit / aggregate / SecAgg / candidate / governance
replay.parity: payloads and event kinds equal to the source stream excluding run_id, event ids and timestamps

restart_resume.checkpoint: round boundary after each non-final committed round; binds run id, protocol id, cohort identity, algorithm, last committed round, state sha, state file sha, event count
restart_resume.resume: RUNNING run with a valid checkpoint is resumed from the next round by the recovering process
restart_resume.invalid: RUNNING run without a valid checkpoint or with inconsistent metadata is marked FAILED (never fabricated)
restart_resume.orphan_candidate_artifacts: candidate artifacts of the run without a database row are removed before resume

concurrency.start_returns: promptly; the run executes in a background task
concurrency.blocking_work: each local epoch / aggregation / SecAgg shadow runs in a worker thread so the event loop stays responsive

locality_claim: one-laptop logical isolation only: no hospital, hardware, VM, enclave or privacy claim
forbidden: monitoring or user data in FL
